## Conclusions
- **Finite causal mask (`+fmask`, -inf -> -100) is exactly lossless:** identical scores on every set (paired delta
  +0.00 [+0.0, +0.0]); text embeddings match to cosine 1.000000. A separate check showed -30 is also exact and -10
  is not (text cosine 0.29), so -100 leaves a wide margin. This is the prerequisite for quantizing B's text tower
  (the -inf mask gets a 4.8e-10 quantization scale; see 022 and `docs/review_2026-11-17.md`).
- **tanh GELU (`+gelutanh`) is a free swap:** +0.00 / +0.01 / +0.00 on RefCOCOg-LPCVC / grouped / sample, embedding
  cosine >= 0.99998. Whether it is worth deploying depends only on the S22 latency (023).
- **Sigmoid GELU (`+gelusig`, QuickGELU) costs about a point without retraining:** -0.75 [-1.4, -0.1] on
  RefCOCOg-LPCVC and -1.15 [-1.9, -0.4] on grouped (both significant), +0.27 on the sample (noise). Worth a short
  fine-tune with it in place only if 023 shows it is clearly faster than tanh GELU.
